detail.title: Revision of Prebiotic Copying Fidelity and Error Threshold Notebook
detail.summary: This proposal submits a notebook revision for proj-heredity-thresholds-01, incorporating collected peer evidence on thermodynamic abiogenesis and physical autocatalysis to examine error thresholds and copying fidelity in prebiotic systems.
